source:
Realistic Wheelie Game Prompt

Create a realistic 3D wheelie game inspired by Wheelie Life and Wheelie Challenge with high-quality physics, smooth controls, and realistic bike handling.

Gameplay

- Realistic wheelie balancing using throttle, rear brake, and body lean.
- Physics-based suspension and tire grip.
- Manual, stoppie, and combo trick system.
- First-person and third-person cameras.
- Day/night cycle and weather options.
- Online multiplayer with free roam and wheelie competitions.
- XP progression, achievements, and leaderboards.

Bikes

Include realistic licensed-inspired models (without using trademarks directly) based on popular bikes such as:

- Surron Light Bee X
- Talaria Sting MX5
- E Ride Pro SS
- Rawrr Mantis
- Arctic Leopard
- Yamaha YZ125
- Yamaha YZ250F
- Yamaha YZ450F
- Honda CRF250R
- Honda CRF450R
- KTM 125 SX
- KTM 250 SX-F
- KTM 450 SX-F
- Kawasaki KX250
- Kawasaki KX450
- Suzuki RM-Z250
- Suzuki RM-Z450
- GasGas MC series
- Husqvarna FC series
- Mountain bikes
- BMX bikes
- Road bikes
- Dirt jump bikes

Each bike should have:

- Unique power curve
- Weight
- Wheelbase
- Suspension tuning
- Top speed
- Wheelie balance point
- Upgrade system

Customization

- Plastics
- Graphics kits
- Number plates
- Wheels
- Handlebars
- Seats
- Exhausts
- Motors
- Batteries
- Controllers
- Sprockets
- Tires
- Rider helmets
- Riding gear
- Gloves
- Boots
- Bike stance adjustment

Maps

- Large city
- Highway
- Industrial area
- Country roads
- Dirt tracks
- Skatepark
- Parking lots
- Mountain roads
- Beach boardwalk
- Forest trails

Realistic Effects

- Rear tire smoke
- Dust
- Dirt spray
- Sparks from tail scraping
- Metal scraping sounds
- Tail scrape score multiplier
- Wheel sparks when landing
- Burnouts
- Suspension compression
- Engine vibration
- Dynamic lighting
- Motion blur
- Rain reflections

Tail Scraping

When the rider balances too high:

- The rear fender or scrape bar contacts the ground.
- Generate realistic sparks.
- Play metal scraping audio.
- Leave temporary scrape marks.
- Award style points while maintaining control.
- Increase combo multiplier while scraping.

Crash System

- Physics ragdoll.
- Rider separation from bike.
- Bike damage.
- Scratches and broken plastics.
- Slow-motion crashes.
- Replay camera.

Looping Respawn

When the player crashes:

- Fade to black for less than one second.
- Instantly respawn at the last checkpoint.
- Preserve bike customization.
- Reset physics cleanly.
- Restart in a seamless gameplay loop with no loading screens.
- Option for instant retry during challenge modes.

Controls

Mobile:

- Left thumb joystick
- Throttle
- Front brake
- Rear brake
- Lean forward
- Lean backward
- Clutch
- Gear shifting
- Camera switch

Controller:

- Analog throttle
- Analog brakes
- Manual clutch
- Full vibration feedback

Audio

- Realistic engine sounds for every bike.
- Electric motor whine for e-bikes.
- Tire noise.
- Wind effects.
- Tail scrape grinding.
- Crash sounds.
- Environmental ambience.

Graphics

- Unreal Engine 5 quality visuals.
- Lumen lighting.
- Nanite assets.
- HDR.
- 60-120 FPS support.
- High-quality reflections.
- Detailed rider animations.
- Realistic wheel deformation under load.

Game Modes

- Free Ride
- Wheelie Challenge
- Longest Wheelie
- Online Multiplayer
- Drift Mode
- Time Trial
- Skill Challenges
- Freestyle Sessions

AI Riders

- Dynamic difficulty.
- Competitive races.
- Wheelie battles.
- Realistic mistakes and recoveries.

Overall goal: create the most realistic and polished wheelie game possible, with advanced physics, immersive visuals, responsive controls, extensive bike customization, satisfying tail-scraping mechanics with sparks and sound effects, and an instant looping respawn system that keeps gameplay fast and continuous.

answers.ask: Is this one connected open world you can ride between all ten areas in, or ten separate maps you pick from a menu?
answers.answer: Use ten separate maps selected from a menu, so each area can be focused and run smoothly while supporting its intended riding style.

answers.ask: How far across should the city be - a few blocks, or a full drivable metro?
answers.answer: Make the city a compact few-block urban map with connected streets, intersections, and riding spots rather than a full metro.

config.genre_evidence: The game is built around realistic vehicle operation: "high-quality physics," "realistic bike handling," wheelie balancing with "throttle, rear brake, and body lean," and bikes with unique "power curve," "weight," "wheelbase," and "suspension tuning." Its primary space is ten selectable free-riding maps for vehicle control and tricks, rather than a finite race track. "Competitive races," "Time Trial," and online wheelie competitions are secondary modes.

extras.text: Ten separate rideable maps are selected from a menu rather than connected as one continuous world.
Place restart checkpoints throughout challenge routes for instant crash respawns.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Shared Persistent World: No personal plot at all — one common world everybody operates in together.

INCLUDE:
- Progression Circulation: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.
- Hauling Routes: Vehicle-width roads between extraction ground and processing structures.
- Physics Contraption: Ramps, ragdoll props, and breakable assemblies whose reactions are the entertainment.
- Ambient Population: The non-hostile characters who inhabit the space — shopkeepers, wandering crowds, ambient animals, a named figure players come to see — and the ground they occupy.
- Water Body: Standing or flowing water as a real feature of the map — a lake, river, sea, or pool — whether swum through or treated as a barrier.
- Settlement: Built-up ground at a stated density — a hamlet, a town, or a dense city block grid — rather than scattered individual buildings.
- Terrain Relief: Natural landform shaping the ground: hills, mountains, cliffs, a valley, or a canyon.
